purpose: Explain a situation or ask for its background.
keywords: Plain clause + のです; conversational んです; noun / な-adjective + なのです.
The thing is, the trains are not running.
I have an exam tomorrow, you see.
formation: Plain clause + のです; conversational んです; noun / な-adjective + なのです.
restrictions: It connects to an understood situation; it is not required for every neutral statement.
mistake: Use 静かなんです, not 静かだんです.
